scope: Independent read-only review of Task2 interval shape/domain patch; no model evaluation, optimization, simulation, challenge data, or public answers.
verdict: No implementation blocker for the narrow interval guard.

checks.producer_schema: Exact five-key match. Producer maps population1/population2 to mainland/island and generations_since_contact to generations_since_migration.

valid_actual_entrypoints.includes: ordinary complete intervals; zero migration intervals and zero contact intervals with contact point at 0 or split boundary; actual producer output from synthetic records

checks.domain: Positive population sizes and split time; nonnegative contact time and migration; finite ordered pairs; exact parameter set.
checks.scope_preserved: No bootstrap denominator, coverage, generating-model adequacy, selected endpoint reconstruction, or scientific readiness is established. Marginal interval endpoints are not treated as a joint parameter vector.

nonblocking_test_observation.detail: Existing-output regression uses .freeze.json.* whereas atomic_json temporary prefix is freeze.json.; independent actual-main checks cover the correct prefix, including late writer failure.
